title: Add compact shopping list setting
description: Add a persisted global compact shopping-list toggle to SettingsView using the specified AppStorage key and default-off behavior.
acceptance_criteria: SettingsView declares AppStorage for shoppingList.compactMode with a default false value.
A Shopping lists settings section exposes a user-facing compact-mode toggle.
The setting is stored as a global persisted preference rather than per-list or per-scene state.

handoff_summary.completed: AppStorage property declared; Shopping lists section with Toggle rendered in SettingsView form.
handoff_summary.risks: None. Change is additive and touches only SettingsView.
handoff_summary.next_action: Tester agent should verify the toggle appears in Settings and the AppStorage key persists across launches.
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: Downstream beads that read `shoppingList.compactMode` from AppStorage must use the exact key string; no structural conflicts expected.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: Placed the "Shopping lists" section first in the Form so the most commonly changed preference is at the top.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: No tests added; UI-level verification of the toggle and persistence is deferred to the tester agent.
handoff_summary.known_limitations: SourceKit reports pre-existing unresolved-type errors for AisleCatalog, RecipesFolderStore, RecipesFolderPicker — these are project-context issues unrelated to this change.

conflict_risks: Downstream beads that read `shoppingList.compactMode` from AppStorage must use the exact key string; no structural conflicts expected.

execution_history.summary: Added `@AppStorage("shoppingList.compactMode")` property (default `false`) and a "Shopping lists" Form section with a compact-mode Toggle to SettingsView.
